mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.author_id AS authorId, e.name AS authorName, n.title, n.content, n.type, DATE_FORMAT(n.last_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS lastDate, DATE_FORMAT(n.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.is_pinned AS isPinned FROM notice n JOIN account a ON n.author_id = a.account_id JOIN employee e ON a.emp_no = e.emp_no ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (author_id, title, content, type, is_pinned, created_at, last_date, view_count) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{isPinned}, #{createdAt}, #{lastDate}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, last_date = #{lastDate} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND author_id = #{authorId}
UPDATE notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
